eips.title: Bundled Attestation Propagation
eips.summary: Simulation results presented showing bundled attestation propagation reduces bandwidth by nearly half and improves goldfish vote latency by over 20%.

moments.context: Kamil suggested discussing EIP-8334 if time permits; Sukun noted the CL teams he wanted to pitch it to were absent.
Sukun mentioned that doing EIP-8334 eliminates the need for topic prioritization, saving enough bandwidth for vote propagation in the current network.
Sukun presented simulation results with EIP-8334, showing attestation traffic reduced by roughly half and goldfish votes propagating about 20% faster at P99.
Sukun showed comparison graphs of traffic with and without EIP-8334, noting most traffic is FFG votes and EIP-8334 significantly reduces it.
Sukun showed Scenario 3 without EIP-8334 noting it works but is at the edge, and argued EIP-8334 would enable 4-slot rounds with 8-slot finality.

eips.title: Fast Execution Payload Broadcast
eips.summary: Referenced as a simple near-term step for fast execution payload broadcast that frees bandwidth and could be iterated toward more advanced techniques like zcast.

moments.context: Sukun noted that EIP-8334 frees up bandwidth space that can be used for bigger payloads via 8411 and other things.
Sukun mentioned that with 8411, payload propagation time would be much lower than the 2-second figure shown for a 256KB payload.
Kamil described 8411 as super simple and asked Csaba how zcast techniques could build on it iteratively toward future forks.
Csaba explained that 8411's segmentation gain is the minimum, and several zcast techniques can be applied on top of 8411 as local implementation policy without protocol changes.

eips.title: RowDAS - Distributed Blob Reconstruction
eips.summary: Named as one of the sampled-broadcast schemes zcast aims to be able to serve.

moments.context: Csaba listed RowDAS among the schemes zcast should cover: "sample broadcast as it is done in FullDAS, or to be able to do what RowDAS is doing".
